market_thesis: English-speaking French-property buyers face a mandatory, French-language multi-report DDT during a consequential transaction; exact Amazon competition is weak and adjacent newcomer evidence exists but is modest.
product_thesis: A bounded report-to-questions field guide that teaches buyers to extract findings, identify what each diagnostic does not establish, cross-check reports and create written follow-up for their notaire or qualified professional.
buyer: English-speaking buyer of an existing French home
trigger: receipt of the DDT before signing or completing the purchase
jtbd: understand what the dossier says, what it does not say, and which written questions require answers before commitment
prior_knowledge: none; French terms introduced only where required
promise: Turn a dense French DDT into a traceable map of findings, boundaries, missing evidence and next questions.
non_promises: not a building survey or diagnosis
not energy, engineering, health or financial advice
does not recommend whether to buy a property
paid_value: Works directly against the buyer’s real dossier and prevents translation from becoming unsupported interpretation.
commercial_differentiation: actual DDT → report facts and scope boundaries → cross-report checks and professional questions
free_alternative: French official explanations, machine translation and the buyer’s notaire
raw_to_product_transformation: official report structure plus a synthetic example → extraction/boundary/question method → buyer-owned decision record
language: EN with essential French document terms
trim_optimization_requirement: YES; compare 7.5x9.25 and 8x10 after content architecture
source_model: current Service-Public/Notaires/legislation-controlled source ledger plus original synthetic report fragments
rights_model: paraphrase official explanations; reproduce only verified government material; all report fragments and diagrams original
volatility: MEDIUM; source refresh before publication and at least annually
author_model: neutral pseudonym; no invented legal, surveying, estate-agent or engineering credentials
factual_qa: every current claim mapped to controlling source; independent claim-ledger audit and pre-publication refresh
language_qa: English editorial QA plus French terminology verification against controlling forms/sources
product_quality_qa: representative sample must prove report → boundary → question mechanism and writable print ergonomics
editorial_formalism_qa: reject repeated empty templates, overconfident paraphrase, slide-deck pagination and generic warnings
technical_qa: print TOC, safe margins, embedded fonts, readable synthetic fragments, PDF preflight and optional EPUB accessibility
commercial_package_requirements: current Amazon rescan, truthful independent positioning, pricing from frozen pagination and no professional-affiliation claims
pricing_hard_gate: final price only after final page count and current KDP print cost
kill_conditions: current Amazon rescan finds a direct DDT workbook with meaningful traction
safe boundary between explanation and professional advice cannot be maintained
authoritative current sources do not cover a material chapter
